tasks.subject: Task 1: menu_spec.py + structure test
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create the platform-neutral menu definition and a pure-Python test that locks its structure, taxonomy, and action-key contracts.

**Files:** Create `menu_spec.py`; Test `tests/test_menu_spec.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:** menu_spec imports with no AppKit dep; top-level order Applio/File/Process/Window/Help; no app.settings, no Edit; key contracts hold; `venv_macos/bin/python tests/test_menu_spec.py` exits 0.

**Verify:** `venv_macos/bin/python tests/test_menu_spec.py` → `All menu_spec tests passed.`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["menu_spec.py", "tests/test_menu_spec.py"], "verifyCommand": "venv_macos/bin/python tests/test_menu_spec.py", "acceptanceCriteria": ["menu_spec imports with no AppKit dependency", "top-level order correct", "no app.settings, no Edit", "key contracts hold", "test exits 0"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: applio_update_check.py + version-compare test
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Port the existing GitHub update check into a shared module with a corrected packaging.version comparison, locked by tests.

**Files:** Create `applio_update_check.py`; Modify `tests/test_menu_spec.py`; port source `macos_wrapper.py:729-830`, `197-229`.

**Acceptance Criteria:** is_update_available uses packaging.version (fail-safe); fetch_latest_release returns dict/None; check_for_updates_interactive runs network off main thread; constants resolve as today; version-compare tests pass.

**Verify:** `venv_macos/bin/python tests/test_menu_spec.py` → exit 0 (incl. version tests).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["applio_update_check.py", "tests/test_menu_spec.py"], "verifyCommand": "venv_macos/bin/python tests/test_menu_spec.py", "acceptanceCriteria": ["packaging.version compare, fail-safe", "fetch returns dict/None", "interactive runs off main thread", "constants resolve", "version tests pass"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Launcher PyObjC renderer + action wiring
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Render MENU with PyObjC (shortcuts + standard selectors + tag-based dispatch), replace `_setup_menu`, add launcher action methods, rewire `checkUpdates_`, gate data items on first-run.

**Files:** Modify `applio_launcher.py` (import NSAlternateKeyMask + `import menu_spec`; MenuActionHandler runDispatch_+_dispatch_table; _setup_menu body; _mods_to_mask/_fill_ns_menu/_find_item_by_tag; _build_launcher_dispatch with ZERO-ARG callables (wrap sender-taking `*_` methods as `lambda: self.X_(None)`); checkUpdates_ rewire; setDataLocation_ guard; app menu left UNTITLED).

**Acceptance Criteria:** menu order + shortcuts work; Check for Updates shows real alert; data items disabled until first-run + reveal resolves fresh dir; guide opens bundled html; git status clean.

**Verify:** `venv_macos/bin/python applio_launcher.py` (foreground) → menu/shortcuts; `git status -sb` clean.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["applio_launcher.py"], "verifyCommand": "venv_macos/bin/python applio_launcher.py", "acceptanceCriteria": ["menu order + shortcuts", "real update alert", "first-run gating + fresh reveal", "guide opens", "git clean"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Launcher dynamic state
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Drive process.status and exists: reveal items from the 2s timer via self._dynamic_items.

**Files:** Modify `applio_launcher.py` `_update_menu_state` (locate by signature `def _update_menu_state(self):`; was ~L3634 pre-Task-3); add `_find_item_by_key` (reads `self._key_to_tag`, populated by Task 3's `_fill_ns_menu`) + module-level `_find_item_by_tag`; SKIP status items in the enable loop (title-only, stays disabled).

**Acceptance Criteria:** status shows No active processes / ● Training: <name>; status line stays DISABLED; reveal items enable/disable by exists: path; first-run gating; timer never raises.

**Verify:** Launch, start training → status updates within ~2s; create assets/audios → Inference Outputs enables.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["applio_launcher.py"], "verifyCommand": "venv_macos/bin/python applio_launcher.py", "acceptanceCriteria": ["status line correct", "reveal exists enabling", "first-run gating", "timer never raises"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Launch-time update check
tasks.description:
**Goal:** On launcher startup, silently check GitHub on a daemon thread; alert only if newer.

**Files:** Modify `applio_launcher.py` `run()` (~L3095-3119, hook before runEventLoop); add `_launch_time_update_check`.

**Acceptance Criteria:** silent at current version; one alert with fake-low version; silent offline; no startup/timer blocking.

**Verify:** Force VERSION=0.0.1 → one alert; restore → silent.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["applio_launcher.py"], "verifyCommand": "venv_macos/bin/python applio_launcher.py", "acceptanceCriteria": ["silent at current", "alert on fake-low", "silent offline", "no blocking"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Wrapper pywebview renderer (standalone static subset)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace get_native_menu() with a spec-driven static pywebview renderer, suppress auto View/Edit, use shared update check.

**Files:** Modify `macos_wrapper.py:1629-1687` (render_pywebview + _build_wrapper_dispatch + _open_bundled_guide); webview.start site (~L1996); set `webview.settings['SHOW_DEFAULT_MENUS']=False` BEFORE start (NOT a `webview.start` kwarg — verified); wire window.minimize/show_main to real pywebview Window actions (zoom/bring_all_to_front omitted, not no-ops); add top-level `import subprocess` + `import webbrowser`.

**Acceptance Criteria:** standalone shows correct order, single bold app menu, no View/Edit; Check for Updates uses shared check; no lambda:None no-ops; get_native_menu gone; standalone Window = Minimize + Show Main Window (real actions).

**Verify:** `venv_macos/bin/python macos_wrapper.py` (standalone) → correct menu; `rg -n "lambda: None" macos_wrapper.py` no menu matches.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["macos_wrapper.py"], "verifyCommand": "venv_macos/bin/python macos_wrapper.py", "acceptanceCriteria": ["standalone menu correct", "no View/Edit, single app menu", "shared update check", "no no-ops; get_native_menu gone"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Bundle the Studio Production Guide
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Ship STUDIO_PRODUCTION_GUIDE.html (build-time conversion) and wire datas.

**Files:** Modify `Applio.spec:4` (datas); `build_macos.py` (add render_guide_html + call after pre_build_patch); `requirements_macos.txt` (add markdown).

**Acceptance Criteria:** html exists in bundle + renders; conversion idempotent + .md fallback; Help opens it; git clean post-build.

**Verify:** `venv_macos/bin/python build_macos.py` then `ls dist/Applio.app/Contents/Resources/STUDIO_PRODUCTION_GUIDE.html`. Never `import build_macos` to test.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Applio.spec", "build_macos.py", "requirements_macos.txt", "STUDIO_PRODUCTION_GUIDE.html"], "verifyCommand": "venv_macos/bin/python build_macos.py && ls dist/Applio.app/Contents/Resources/STUDIO_PRODUCTION_GUIDE.html", "acceptanceCriteria": ["html in bundle renders", "idempotent + fallback", "Help opens it", "git clean"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
